title: Mordheim KB catalogue — prose rules of catalog/rules
description: The two catalogues that hold rule text and no runtime classification: `core-combat.yaml` (canonical combat rules as editorial text) and `special-rules.yaml` (cross-band rule text, kept empty of band-specific rules and promoted here only after an equivalence review). Band rules reuse these texts through `rule_ref` instead of repeating prose.

note.description: Editorial note about the catalogue as a whole.
